title: Thought my dog was still alive
content: In my mallworld, there seems to be a lot of almost-subunderground apt complexes that all connect to each other (this is my favorite/most comforting place) and somewhere nearby is an equally sub-underground college/school or some sort. There’s a lot of glass and filing cabinets vs. dingy beds, wooden stairs and sofas. The apts are where I first saw my dad in a dream after he past - ever since then I kept dreaming of mallworld… I thought it’d stop but its prob been close to. year now. Anyway, just the other day, I dreamt of seeing my dog in one of the apt rooms… I could almost feel his fat belly. But I remember being pretty confused… I was taking to him (like I normally would) but I said “I thought I had a dream that you died” and it felt so real - like it does in real life when you thought you dreamt something but just brush it off. In the dream, he was *right there* and I immediately thought I only dreamt he died and I had a whole thought process of “was that a dream??” (Which was trippy to do in a dream) and I believed it - I believed that dream reality was real reality for a second. So weird, idk.
